tickets.label: Tickets
tickets.description: Multiple ticket types; each type opens a private channel visible to the chosen roles.
tickets.welcome: Hello {user}, your “{type}” ticket is open. Describe your request here, the team will reply. Click “Close ticket” once it’s resolved.

feedback.disabled: ❌ This module is disabled on this server.

error.notype: ❌ This ticket type no longer exists.
error.max: ❌ You already have {max} open ticket(s). Close it before opening a new one.
error.noperm: ❌ I lack the “Manage Channels” permission to create the ticket.
error.create: ❌ Could not create the ticket channel. Check my permissions and the category.

close.confirm: Close this ticket? The channel will be deleted.
close.notFound: ❌ This ticket cannot be found or is already closed.
close.cantClose: ⛔ Only the author, the type staff or an admin can close it.
